podcast.body: A top 10 modern rock hit from L7's acclaimed 1992 album "Bricks Are Heavy." Its success contributed to the visibility of female-fronted bands during the Grunge era. "spawned the top 10 modern rock hit, Pretend We're Dead."

podcast.body: This song is from L7's 1992 album "Bricks Are Heavy," which became their best-known work. It was written by DeNita Sparks, who was renowned for her fearless personality. "It was written by DeNita Sparks, and there are many stories about her fearlessness."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was the prominent single from L7's 1992 breakthrough album, "Bricks Are Heavy." Donita Sparks contributed both vocals and guitar to the track and is credited as its writer. "From 1992, that's L7 and pretend we're dead, featuring the vocals and guitar of Danita Sparks. She also wrote that song."
